Title: Protected in the Shelter of the Most High

Verses.1:
Whoever lives in the shelter of the Most High, [*]
	will find rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
Verses.2:
I will say of the LORD, "My refuge and my fortress, [*]
	my God, my trust is in Him."
Verses.3:
For it is He who rescues you from the fowler's snare, [*]
	and from the deadly plague.
Verses.4:
He will cover you with His feathers, [t]
	and you will take refuge under His wings, [*]
	His faithfulness is a shield and wall.
Verses.5: You will not fear the terror by night, nor the arrow that flies by day, [t]
Verses.6:
nor the plague that stalks in darkness, [*]
	nor the destruction that strikes at noon.
Verses.7:
A thousand will fall at your side, [t]
	and ten thousand at your right hand, [*]
	but you will stay out of reach.
Verses.8:
You will only look with your eyes, [*]
	and watch as the wicked are punished.
Verses.9:
For the LORD is my refuge, [*]
	and you have made the Most High your fortress.
Verses.10:
No evil will touch you, [*]
	nor plague approach your tent.
Verses.11:
For He will give orders to His angels concerning you, [*]
	to protect you in all your ways.
Verses.12:
On their hands they will carry you, [*]
	so your foot will never strike against a stone.
Verses.13:
You will tread on the lion and cobra, [*]
	and You will trample the young lion and the serpent.
Verses.14:
"Since they have loved Me, I will rescue them. [*]
	I will protect them, because they know My name.
Verses.15:
They will call to Me, and I will answer them; [t]
	I will be with them in trouble, [*]
	I will rescue and honor them.
Verses.16:
I will satisfy them with long lives, [*]
	and I will show them My salvation."
